## History

Patty inherited Patty's Place from her brother [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) through his will. Her former home later became the residence where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settled into during their time at college.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_
